title: Jamaican Beef Tagine
description: A hearty, comforting dish featuring snappy beef cutlets in a rich Jamaican spice blend. Perfect for a sick day or a chilly evening.
instructions: Season the beef cutlets with salt and black pepper.
Heat the coconut oil in a large ceramic tagine over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef cutlets until browned on both sides, about 3 minutes per side. Set aside.
Add the onions to the tagine and cook until they start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger to the tagine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the allspice, cumin, smoked paprika, and cocoa powder to the tagine and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk to the tagine and stir to combine.
Return the beef cutlets to the tagine and simmer, covered, until the meat is tender, about 20-25 minutes.
Remove the tagine from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Transfer the beef cutlets to an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Strain the sauce from the tagine and discard the solids.
Return the beef cutlets to the tagine and simmer the sauce over low heat until it thickens, about 5 minutes.
